purpose: Re-encode complete audited E136 fit routes into public-state/candidate-card terminal-value examples. No new branch collection.
selection: All1536 originally assigned fit families, all4 first-card branches each. Keep forced root and at most8 later recorded reward-card choices per act ranked by SHA256(prefix index), regardless of outcome. No pre-intervention rows. Root/candidate order preserved.
target: Binary Heart result of this exact route after the recorded card choice, with frozen parent continuation. Later choices are selected by the parent, not counterfactual alternatives. This is supervised fixed-policy Q estimation, not on-policy RL.
features: Allowlisted public state and chosen card descriptor, with current boss/map/deck/card specials/relic identity and counters/potions. Internal event scratch, reward probabilities, seed/RNG, prefix identity, future actions and terminal metadata excluded.

planned_learning_comparison.family_folds: original E73 SHA256 modulo3; all same-seed branches/states remain together
planned_learning_comparison.model: new jointly learned float32 MLP: public state/candidate ->128 SiLU ->64 SiLU ->1 logit; no frozen BC representation

training.objective: unweighted BCE over the predeclared hierarchical training distribution; final checkpoint only

planned_learning_comparison.sampling: Both arms uniform fit family then uniform first-card branch. root_only uses forced root. root_plus_later uses root with probability1/2, else uniform available later act then uniform retained row; branches without later rows use root. No win oversampling or length weighting.
planned_learning_comparison.deploy: Change only Act1 first-fight last card reward; greedy Q logit, ties to parent. Whole-menu unknown card IDs relative to fit-root support fall back to parent. Native feature and choice verification before evaluation.
planned_learning_comparison.gate: Each arm must gain at least30/1536 versus parent out of fold and descriptive paired p<.025. No holdout fitting/grid; passing final model and historical holdout admission require later explicit recorded root decision.
planned_learning_comparison.limits: Additional states are correlated observations, not new independent families. Root-only control separates representation/objective change from additional within-trajectory information.
